scope: Whole native MCP note-tool validation/forwarding, not actual server note storage or peer contactability.
explicit_boundaries: Only lowercase mailbox: at a token boundary is a field; Mailbox:, notmailbox: and colon-prefixed data are not fields.
Only did and did-<two lowercase hex> namespaces get the new guard; generic namespaces remain free-form.
The room value is one whitespace-delimited token after the official sweep; following metadata is not part of that name.
Valid room grammar does not establish room existence, DID-note fingerprint validity, ownership, authenticated contact or encryption.
Raw values/conditions are forwarded unchanged; server storage sweep is not executed by the local recorder.
Generic note errors409/422/429 are preserved with one origin request; no error retries.
Peer uses of world-writable mailbox hints still need authenticated binding when security depends on them; no new binding is supplied.
